response.rationale: A and B seem to describe the same capability, seen at different levels. B, "Remote hive weight monitoring", rests on ScaleRepository (node 18ab235f6c31a91a) and WeightReadingRepository (node 47ce227c703f72aa), the storage classes for scales and their weight readings. A, "Remote hive weight monitoring and swarm alerting", uses those same two classes and adds ScaleService (node f7e458262ae72ac4), the business-logic class that sits on top of them. The extra "swarm alerting" part of A most likely comes from the same weight data, since a sudden weight drop is how a swarm is detected. That makes it part of the weight-monitoring capability rather than a separate one, so B reads as the storage side of what A describes. I'm not more confident because A's label is clearly broader, and B lacks the service class where alerting logic would live. The excerpts show only the class declarations, so I can't confirm from the code that the alerting is weight-based.
